title: The first Internet worm was a survey that escaped
body: Robert Morris released his 1988 worm to measure the size of the early Internet. A design choice made it reinfect machines it already occupied, so it multiplied until roughly a tenth of the network's machines clogged. Morris became the first conviction under the US Computer Fraud and Abuse Act.
source_hint: US v. Morris (2d Cir. 1991); Cornell report
